messages.subject: Configure credible intervals
parts:
Is there an easy way to tell brms to calculate credible intervals other than 95%?

  Titus

messages.author: 6e3dd74b422c061b
messages.subject: Re: [brms-users] Configure credible intervals
parts:
Not in summary, but it could be worth adding just an argument.

What you can always do is extracting the posterior samples for instance via

ps <- posterior_samples(fit, pars = <pars you want>)

and compute the quantiles manually

apply(ps, 2, quantile, probs = c(0.01, 0.99))
